tools.name: audit_website
tools.description: Audits a public website: crawls up to 5 pages and returns a health score from 0 to 100, the top issues (SEO, page speed, broken links, accessibility, security headers), a fix prompt the user can copy into their coding agent, and a link to the full report. Use it when the user asks to audit, check or

tools.name: audit_checks
tools.description: Lists the checks the free website audit runs, how many pages it scans and how long it takes. Use it to explain what an audit score covers.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "audit_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
